content: Bab-Jehová Salomónʼbogwa igar-mesisad
Salomón, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg sobsagua, na e-neg obelosbargua, degine, bela ibmar-abeged sobsabargua,
geb Bab-Jehová gannar Salomónʼse magarononikid. Ar igi gebe Gabaón-neggweburgi ese magarononigusa, deyobi ese magarononi gusbalid

Agi, Bab-Jehová, Salomónʼga sogded: “Ise-wilegar be anse gornaigusadi an be-itosad. We-anse-goled-neg be-anga-sobsadi, angadga an imaknonikid. An egi degisadegu gudii guoed. We-neg an nue-sabgudii guoed, an egi nakuledii guoed, deyob degisadeguoed.
”Igi be-bab-David gudii gusa,

content.text: an be-bab-Davidʼga ibmar-imakoye sogsayobi an imakoed.

content: ”Deun an ega sogsagu: ‘Israel-dulemar-iduega be-wagan be-sorba rey-gangi-siged surguosurye.’ Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar-e-dummadga-be-gudiid an be-ogannogoed.
”We-anse-goled-neg an nug-imaksadi, an obanoed. Israel-dulemar dodolegedga gudoed, degi, bela dule-bamalad egi alledii gudmaloed.

Emi anse-gorleged-neg be dakedi, gwen akar-guosuliyob dakleged. Degite, e-ibagan-nonikir, bela ayarnonikoed. Dulemar we-neg-anga-soblesad deyob dakarmardibe, geger dakdemaloed, egi dododmaloed. Egisnai-gudmaloed: ‘¿Ibiga Bab-Jehová weyob we-neg imaksa? ¿Ibiga Bab-Jehová weyob Israel-dulemar-imaksabali?’

”E-abin sogdemaloed: ‘Ade, Israel-dulemar e-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼgi bangusmalad. We-Bab-Dummad Egipto-yargi e-dadgan-onos gusanad. Degite, Israel-dulemar bab-dummagan-baigan na e-bab-dummadga imakdemalad, a-nug-odummodii gudmalad. Agala, Bab-Jehová ega bonigan uknonikid.’ ”
Salomón ibmar-bukidar imaksad
Salomón Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neg sobsad, geb e-meged-neg sobsabalid. Bela birga-dulagwen (20) gagasad.

Agine, Salomón, Tiro-neggwebur-e-rey-Hiram bela Salomón-abegedba ega urwar-suarmar-uksad-ular, ega baryawarmar-uksabalid-ular, degine, ega ormar-uksabalid-ular, Hiramʼga Galilea-yargi-neggweburmar-bukwad gwadulagwen (20) uksad.
Hiram, Salomón-neggweburmar-ega-uksad-daknaega Tiro-neggweburgi node gusad. Hiram, neggweburmar-daksagua, abessulid.
Agi, Salomónʼga sogded: “Andi, an-aiye an be-bienad. We-neggweburmar-be-anga-uksad gwen nabirsulid.” Geb a-neggweburmar Cabul-Yalaye onug-imaksad. Deyob amba we-garda-narmaklenaidse, bileged.
Ar Hiramʼdina, Rey-Salomónʼga or nibir-milibaabak gaka dulataled-ilagugle-aidiku (8,700) uksa gusanad.
Rey-Salomón dule-bulegan-arbamalad-amisad, ega we-negmar sobega:

Egipto-rey-Faraón, Gezer-neggwebur-oitos gusad. Gezer-dulemar-ibe ablis eos gusad, e-negmar-ogumaksa gusad, bela Canaán-dulemar Gezer-neggweburgi-gudimalad ogilos gusad. Geb sorbali, Faraón, e-sisgwa-Salomón-nikunaigu, a-neggwebur e-sisgwaga uksad.
Agala, Salomón,
Deginbali, Salomón na neg-bamalad-soboye sogsagusadi, bela sobsad:
Israel-dulemarsulid-e-wagan-napi-besmalad, wemalad:
Degisoggu, Salomón, a-dulemar, undar-arbalegedgi oarbaega imaksad. Amba deyobi, we-garda-narmaklenaigu, arbadimalad.
Salomón, Israel-dulemardi deyob oarbaega imaksasulid. Israel-dulemar we-ibmarga gusmalad:

content.text: Aginbali, Salomón, dulemar dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabo-gakambe (550) ega nakulemalaga nug-imaksabalid.

content: Faraón-e-sisgwa, David-e-neggweburgi-gudiidgi, Salomón-ega-neg-sobsadse nonigua, Salomón, neg-ollor-Miloʼye-nugad sobsad.

Salomón, Bab-Jehováʼga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-sobsa-gusadgi, birgagine, ilapaa ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged ukdaed. Degi, gwenatigwar-guedga-ibmar-ukleged ukdabalid. Agine, ina-wawadikid Bab-Jehová-asabin-bukwad ogumakdabalid. Deyobi, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi ibmar-imakleged imakdii gusad.
Rey-Salomón, Ezión-Geber-neggweburgi ur-diakinmalad sobsabalid. Ezión-Geber, Edom-yar-naidgi siid. A-neggwebur, Elot-neggweburye-nugad-naba, Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-gakaba siid.
Hiram, e-selamar-demargi-durdakarmalad a-urmargi-arbaega barmisad. Amala, Salomón-e-sordaganmala, nade gusmalad.
We-dulemar, Ofirʼye-neg-nugadse nade gusmalad. Agi, or nibir-milidulagwen-gakambe gaka dulataled-ilabaabak-aidiku-amis (30,800), Rey-Salomónʼga senonimalad.
